summary: Author content/buildings/ to S3's contract and the presentation-override pack manifest schema, with the two validator blocks and the Rust equality test that hold them.

coordination.notes: building.rs is touched in exactly one hunk -- a single test appended at the END of the test module -- because three other lanes are appending fields and tests to the same file and an end-of-module append merges. validate.mjs gains two blocks (buildings, packs) and no existing block is edited. Packs are validated but deliberately NOT bundled: they are separate artifacts (E9 builds the .pck), so build-content-bundle.mjs gains buildings only. packs/pack.presentation.fixture/ is a FIXTURE that proves the schema at targetLevel fade_to_black; the adult pack is not authored in this repository and no explicit content exists here.
